# Deliverables Manifest — [Product]

Created at Architecture. Maintained continuously. Reconciled at Release Candidate.

**Rule (Agreement C):** nothing appears in sales copy as included until its status is `built` *and* the artifact has been seen by whoever writes the claim. Pre-production copy referencing a deliverable is marked `[PENDING — DO NOT PUBLISH]` inline.

## Status values

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `planned` | Agreed to exist. Nothing produced. Not claimable. |
| `drafted` | Source exists. No shippable artifact. Not claimable. |
| `built` | Shippable artifact exists at a named path or URL. Claimable once seen. |
| `verified` | Artifact opened and checked against its claims. Claimable. |
| `cut` | Removed from this release. Must not appear in copy. |

## Notes

Record here any deliverable that was promised verbally or in an offer decision before it existed. That gap is exactly what this manifest exists to catch.
